race.comment: PETA ZOOM (1) is worth forgiving last start after finishing eighth (18.11) from Box 7 at this track over 300m. Has a strong record out of this box with two wins and two minor placings from four starts. Has ability and can bounce back. BIG CUTIE (2) was a last start winner (17.86) from Box 8 at this track. Can go close again if runs up to latest figure. KINGSBRAE MAGGIE (3) quickly into stride to win over the 300m at this track two runs back then raced on speed again when finishing second at this track last start. Has never missed the frame from four starts from this draw, including a win. Can measure up. KARLI MULWEE (8) cannot be overlooked following a recent top-three finish here at this distance.
